description: Use when choosing which Salesforce platform capability to use for a requirement — covering metadata storage (Custom Metadata vs Custom Settings vs Custom Objects), UI framework (LWC vs Aura), integration approach (Platform Events vs Change Data Capture vs Outbound Messaging), and data extension (OmniStudio vs standard automation). Triggers: custom metadata vs custom settings, LWC vs Aura, which salesforce feature to use, platform events vs change data capture, omnistudio vs flow, choose where to store configuration. NOT for automation-specific tool selection between Flow / Apex / Workflow (use admin/process-automation-selection) or for implementing the chosen platform feature.
inputs: Business requirement or technical constraint to evaluate
name: platform-selection-guidance
official_sources: Custom Metadata Types (Metadata API Developer Guide) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_custommetadata.htm — authority for CMT deployment semantics, record structure, and Metadata API coverage

Lightning Web Components Developer Guide — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/component-library/documentation/en/lwc — authority for LWC capabilities, Lightning Message Service, and Aura interoperability (developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/lwc returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-03; LWC-specific claims are marked UNVERIFIED)

Platform Events Developer Guide — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.platform_events.meta/platform_events/platform_events_intro.htm — authority for Platform Events publish/subscribe model, retention windows, and replay semantics

Change Data Capture Developer Guide — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.change_data_capture.meta/change_data_capture/cdc_intro.htm — authority for CDC event model, field-delta payload, retention windows, and Shield extensions (read as the Summer '26 PDF below; it documents no Shield retention extension)

Salesforce Well-Architected — Operational Excellence — https://architect.salesforce.com/well-architected/operational-excellence — framing for deployment simplicity, maintainability, and release pipeline design (HTTP 403 on 2026-10-03; pillar framing follows `standards/well-architected-mapping.md`)

Salesforce Well-Architected — Reliability — https://architect.salesforce.com/well-architected/reliability — framing for feature longevity, deprecation risk, and runtime behavior reliability (HTTP 403 on 2026-10-03, not re-read)

Salesforce Architects: Decision Guide — https://architect.salesforce.com/design/decision-guides — platform feature selection framing and architectural tradeoff analysis (HTTP 403 on 2026-10-03, not re-read)

Apex Developer Guide, Summer '26 (PDF): https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf. "Custom Settings" (list vs hierarchy, packaging, guest-readable unless protected, test isolation, sandbox copy), "Isolation of Test Data from Organization Data in Unit Tests", "Deploy Apex Using Metadata API" and "Metadata" (custom metadata records deployed with `Metadata.Operations.enqueueDeployment()`, protected metadata)

Salesforce Developer Limits and Allocations Quick Reference (PDF): https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf. Custom metadata queries do not count against the SOQL query limit

Metadata API Developer Guide, Summer '26 (PDF): https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf. `CustomMetadata` (record member form `Type.Record` in package.xml), `CustomField.metadataRelationshipControllingField` (metadata relationships), `WorkflowOutboundMessage` (workflow and approval actions)

Platform Events Developer Guide, Summer '26 (PDF): https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/platform_events.pdf. "Event Retention in the Event Bus", "Default Platform Event Allocations for Event Publishing and Delivery" (50,000 / 25,000 / 10,000 per 24 hours, shared with CDC, excludes triggers and flows)

Change Data Capture Developer Guide, Summer '26 (PDF): https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_change_data_capture.pdf. Three-day retention, `changedFields`, five-entity selection limit without add-on, event bus tenant secret rotation every 7 days

Integration Patterns and Practices, Spring '26 v66.0 (PDF): https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/integration_patterns_and_practices.pdf. Outbound messaging retry behavior; platform events published once with no Salesforce-side retry

Lightning Aura Components Developer Guide, Spring '26: local corpus `knowledge/imports/lightning.md`. "Use Lightning Web Components instead of Aura Components" (choose LWC unless a feature is unsupported), "Application Event Propagation" (use Lightning Message Service across the DOM)
outputs: Tradeoff comparison for top 2-3 candidate features
Risk factors for the recommended option
References to implementation skills for the chosen option
